title: AIOS clones allocated to squads
text: AIOS has 250 indexed mind clones. All 250 are formally allocated to squads, with zero unassigned clones and zero missing squad references after the squad reorganization.

title: AIOS memory is local-first with Graphiti outbox
text: Use a local-first AIOS memory layer with JSONL events, facts, decisions, Markdown summaries, and a Graphiti-ready outbox before relying on external memory services.

title: AIOS agent aliases in PowerShell
text: AIOS agent aliases can be loaded with scripts/aios-agent-aliases.ps1. After loading, agents can be called as aios-master, kasim-aslam, traffic-masters-chief, architect, qa, and other indexed agent IDs.

title: Chamar agentes no PowerShell
text: Para chamar agentes no PowerShell, carregue scripts/aios-agent-aliases.ps1 e use comandos como aios-master, kasim-aslam, traffic-masters-chief, architect ou qa.
